repoUrl.description: Repository URL, optionally with /tree/<branch>/<subpath> to pin branch + pom directory.

pomPath.description: Path to the parent pom (default "pom.xml" or the URL-embedded sub-path).

branch.description: Base branch (else URL branch, else repo default).

detectOnly.description: Read-only: report what the pom inherits (its <parent> and imported BOMs) plus a connector edit preview, and STOP without taking a lock or opening a PR. Returns a DETECTED result. Use this first in the chained flow to decide whether to upgrade the BOM before the parent pom.

parentRef.description: Chained flow: repoint THIS pom's <parent> block at a newly-bumped BOM/parent version (e.g. point solutions-parent-pom at the new solutions-bom version). Emits a pomParentVersion edit.

groupId.description: Parent groupId to match (optional; matched loosely when omitted).

bumpOwnVersion.description: Chained flow: force a minor bump of THIS pom's own <version> even when no connectors changed (used when the only reason to release is that the inherited BOM/parent moved).
